## Broadcom Debt Deal Seen Exceeding $70 Billion to Finance AI Custom Silicon Expansion

A $70B+ debt commitment to fund AI silicon buildout—if confirmed—is a generational capital allocation bet that signals Broadcom's conviction in durable custom ASIC demand; the credit market's willingness to absorb this at current rates is also a read on broader risk appetite for AI capex stories.

- Broadcom's pending debt transaction is expected to exceed $70B according to sources cited by CNBC—which, if confirmed, would rank among the largest tech debt raises on record.
- The raise is linked to AI custom silicon capacity expansion.
- The 'sources say' qualifier is a material caveat; the deal is not yet confirmed as closed or formally announced.
- The scale of the transaction is itself a cross-asset signal on credit market appetite for AI-linked issuers.
